LanguageData.HD_Loan_Terms:
Article 3. Delivery and repayment
This loan carries no interest. Sending the agreement uses one primary cell and deducts one financial goodwill per 20 Sthaler. A loan cannot reduce financial goodwill below zero.

A financial caravan arrives in approximately 1–2 days and puts the cash on the ground. The repayment term begins when delivery is completed. Financial goodwill reserved for undelivered funds is returned. Only one open loan per faction is allowed.

Article 4. Overdue loans
No late interest is charged. New loans are unavailable until all overdue principal has been repaid.

LanguageData.HD_Loan_RepaymentTerms:
Article 5. Repayment
Open this agreement through the telegraph and specify a repayment amount. Accessible Sthaler cash can be used for partial or full repayment.

Each 20 Sthaler repaid restores one financial goodwill deducted for the loan. Repayments do not also earn paid-service goodwill. Early and overdue repayment are both accepted.
